newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF says convertible issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: AGF says convertible issue oversubscribed.

text.p: French insurer AGF said on Wednesday that its issuance of subordinated convertible bonds had been oversubscribed.
"The operation was a great success. It was oversubscribed by more than three times by institutional investors," AGF said in a statement.
"The offer was closed as of 11 am (0900 GMT) this morning, earlier than had been anticipated."

AGF said on Tuesday that it issued four billion francs in subordinated convertible bonds as part of a debt restructuring. The placement was being carried out by a banking syndicate led by Goldman Sachs Paris Inc and Cie and Societe Generale.
